create_AVHubertDataset: create an AVHubertDataset instance from a manifest path with audio and video label paths
load_audio_visual: load audio-visual data from a manifest file filtering by max and min sample size
verify_label_lengths: verify audio and label durations are aligned within a tolerance threshold
collater_batch: collate a batch of audio and video samples with labels for model training
add_noise: add random noise to a clean audio waveform at a specified signal-to-noise ratio
